description: Feature schema for static URL-based phishing detection.

url_length.description: Total number of characters in the URL.

hostname_length.description: Number of characters in the hostname.

path_length.description: Number of characters in the URL path.

num_dots.description: Total number of dots in the complete URL.

num_subdomains.description: Estimated number of subdomains based on hostname labels. Returns 0 for IP addresses.

num_hyphens.description: Total number of hyphens in the URL.

num_underscores.description: Total number of underscores in the URL.

num_slashes.description: Total number of forward slashes in the URL.

num_questionmarks.description: Total number of question marks in the URL.

num_equals.description: Total number of equals signs in the URL.

num_digits.description: Total number of numeric digits in the URL.

digit_ratio.description: Ratio of numeric digits to total URL length.

special_char_count.description: Total number of non-alphanumeric characters in the complete URL.

contains_unicode.description: 1 if the hostname contains any non-ASCII character, otherwise 0.

non_ascii_count.description: Number of non-ASCII characters in the hostname.

mixed_script.description: 1 if the hostname contains alphabetic characters identified as belonging to multiple scripts by the current Unicode-name heuristic, otherwise 0.

contains_punycode.description: 1 if any hostname label starts with xn--, otherwise 0.

suspicious_keyword_count.description: Number of configured suspicious keywords found in the URL. Each keyword contributes at most 1.

has_https.description: 1 if the URL scheme is HTTPS, otherwise 0.

has_ip_address.description: 1 if the hostname is a valid IP address, otherwise 0.

label.name: label
label.description: Target class used for supervised machine learning.
label.note: The label is obtained from the dataset and is not generated by the feature extractor.
